warning.title: Important Notice:
warning.text: EX PRO Player is a standalone media player only. It does not provide, host, sell, or include any media content, channels, or subscriptions. Users are responsible for adding and managing their own legally obtained media sources.

whatIsExpro.title: What is EX PRO Player?
whatIsExpro.description: EX PRO Player is a premium playback application developed by Exclusive Movies Ltd. It allows users to organize and play their personal or third-party media sources using supported playlist formats, optimized for TV screens and remote-control navigation. We focus on performance, stability, privacy, and compliance—not content distribution.
highlights: Supports widely used playlist formats (including M3U / M3U8)
Optimized for Smart TVs and large displays
Dedicated sections for Live streams, Movies, Series, and Catch-up (when supported by the source)
Favorites, categories, and search for fast navigation

easeToUse.title: A Cinematic, Easy-to-Use Interface
easeToUse.text: Enjoy a refined dark-gold theme with rich posters, smooth transitions, and layouts designed specifically for the living-room experience.

coreFeatures.title: Core Features
coreFeatures.text: Fast loading and smooth playback Movie and series details with posters and metadata (when available from the source) Multi-language audio and subtitle support (content-dependent) Optimized for remote.

parentalControls.title: Built-In Parental Controls
parentalControls.text: EX PRO Player includes parental control options to help families manage access to content categories. Restrict sections based on preferences or ratings and create a safer viewing environment on shared device.

securePlayback.title: Reliable, Secure Playback
securePlayback.text: Stability is at the core of EX PRO Player. The application is engineered for consistent performance across supported platforms, ensuring smooth navigation and reliable playback without interruptions.
